headline: Rajani Associates acts on Core4 Engineers IPO

detail: Core4 Engineers Limited has raised ₹54.82 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares comprised entirely of a fresh issue. Rajani Associates advised Core4 Engineers as well as the book running lead manager Socradamus Capital Private Limited on this IPO. The Firm's scope of work included conducting legal diligence; and preparing and finalizing the chapters and stock exchange replies thereto. The transaction was led by Sangeeta Lakhi (Senior Partner), with support from Associates Shubh Poddar, Sudhanshu Kulkarni and Ria Rastogi.
